title: D-SP-4 Stage 2b: mission_run MCP tool (forwarded goal with on-demand engine start, status and exit code)
goal: Add the mission_run MCP tool: the daemon runs a forwarded goal the way `susi <goal>` does, holding the on-demand engine-start permission for the mission, and answers with one JSON document {text, status, exit_code} whose exit code comes from the mission status. susi_solve stays as it is; socket_parity maps <goal> to mission_run.
